ra.ct-pancreatitis.limits: Published selected sections only: no original DICOM volume, calibrated full anatomy, validated source phase timing, histology, complete wall/debris extent or patient-specific 3D reconstruction. Original panel labels and source arrows are preserved; their presence does not grant independent anatomical approval. Biliary instrumentation and enteric communication remain explicit alternatives/context for collection gas; infection is not proved by this image alone.
